content:
Alex G: Quick heads-up — planning to flip the `smart_rerank_v2` toggle to canary tomorrow 6am UTC. Need quick checks on sampling, guardrails, and stop rules.
Priya S: what's the proposed audience? mobile only? subset of users?
Alex G: mobile + web, but split: 0.5% web, 0.2% mobile. total ~100k req/day -> ~700/day canary.
Marco L: that seems small; do we have power for signal on CTR/RR quality? p-value likely noisy.
Jenna R: agree. we should use stratified sampling by client version (v>=2.1) and by geography. avoids confounding.
Priya S: what metrics are we watching? conversion, rerank-quality (NDCG), p95 latency, error-rate.
Alex G: yes: primary = rerank_ndcg@10 (increase), secondary = model_latency_p95 (< 50ms delta), error_rate (<0.1% absolute increase). also overall failure count.
Marco L: stopping rule proposal: stop if ndcg drops by >1.5% with p<0.05 OR latency p95 increases >20ms for 15m window OR error_rate increases by >0.2%.
Jenna R: add kill-switch: immediate global disable if error_rate spikes >1% or latency p95 > 200ms.
Alex G: good. ops question: how to configure in LaunchDarkly / internal toggle? snippet:
```yaml
feature: smart_rerank_v2
rules:
  - audience: "client_version >= 2.1 AND geography in (US, EU)"
    rollout:
      web: 0.005
      mobile: 0.002
monitoring:
  metrics:
    - rerank_ndcg@10: increase
    - latency_p95_ms: decrease
    - error_rate: decrease
stop_rules:
  - ndcg_drop_pct: 1.5
    p_value: 0.05
  - latency_p95_ms_increase: 20
  - error_rate_pct_increase: 0.2
```
Priya S: small nit: LD wants percentage as 0-100. so 0.5% -> 0.5 in UI? I think it's 0.5 in code but double-check.
Alex G: thanks — I'll translate. Also will tag experiment id `exp-rr-v2-2026-03-17`.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout for 2026-03-17T06:00:00Z (canary). ci/build: passed, canary flag set in staging.
Marco L: can someone add the test harness to collect ndcg daily and attach to dashboards? I can wire the alert.
Jenna R: @Marco L I can add the dashboard tile; need metric names.
Marco L: metric names: `rerank/ndcg@10`, `serving/latency/p95`, `serving/errors/total`.
Priya S: confirm experiment buckets: control=100k, treatment could be overlapping with other experiments? ensure mutually exclusive.
Alex G: we'll use experiment manager to allocate non-overlap; adding bucketing key `user_session_id`.
ops-bot: reminder: deploy runway window for canary is 06:00-09:00 UTC. oncall: @Jenna R, @Marco L.
Jenna R: ack. I'll be around 05:45-09:30 UTC.
Marco L: I'll stay on pager until 10:00 UTC.
Priya S: quick code review ping @Alex G — small change in feature flag client defaults. plz assign.
Alex G: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/relevance/pull/412 — gentle review appreciated.
Priya S: LGTM, left one comment re: timeout defaults.
Alex G: addressed.
Marco L: post-rollout, let's run 48h A/B analysis and checkpoint at 24h. if ndcg delta >0.5% and p<0.1 we consider promoting to 50%.
Priya S: noted. also add regression test set for rerank quality (20 queries) to run nightly.
Alex G: will add tests and update experiment doc. thanks all :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary rollout started 2026-03-17T06:00:12Z - flags applied to 0.5% web / 0.2% mobile.
ops-bot: oncall handoff note: @Jenna R -> @Marco L at 08:30 UTC.
Jenna R: saw a small spike in p95 ~+12ms at 06:14, still within rule.
Marco L: spikes tracked; setting rolling alert to 10m if p95 > 70ms.
Priya S: any failures in pulling model? logs?
Alex G: one transient model fetch timeout around 06:13, retry succeeded. tracking in PR logs.
Marco L: if we see ndcg drop >1% we'll roll back immediately. fingers crossed.
Priya S: thanks Alex for organizing. :thumbsup:
Alex G: appreciate the fast responses. will post final 24h readout in #eng-platform.
